title: 2012 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Dragon
seo_title: 2012 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Dragon (23 January – 9 February 2013)
description: 2012 is the Year of the Water Dragon (Yang, Ren-chen), from 23 January 2012 to 9 February 2013. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2012.
lead: Born in 2012? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Dragon, but check the date: the 2012 Water Dragon year began on 23 January 2012. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2012: Year of the Water Dragon, from 23 January 2012 to 9 February 2013.

image.alt: Golden Dragon of the Chinese zodiac in front of a moonlit temple
image.caption: Illustration from MyBirthSign's zodiac artwork; it is not a photograph.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2012 was the Year of the Dragon. It began with Lunar New Year on 23 January 2012 and ended on 9 February 2013, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2012 ends in 2, which makes it a Water year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2012 is a Ren-chen year. The same Water Dragon combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1952 before it and 2072 after it.
Lunar New Year 2012 fell on 23 January 2012. Anyone born from 1 January 2012 up to the day before belongs to the previous year's animal, the Rabbit; from 23 January 2012 on, the Dragon.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Dragon guide describes the sign like this: “Confident, charismatic, and ambitious. Dragons draw attention and often rise to leadership naturally.” The usual watch-out: “Can come across as proud or impatient with limitations.”

The Water element adds its own flavour. Water years bring intuition, adaptability, and calm wisdom. People of this element tend to be thoughtful, diplomatic, and perceptive. Read more in our Water element guide, or the full Year of the Dragon page.
Careers often linked with the Dragon: leadership, entrepreneurship, entertainment, real estate.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2012
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Dragon's best matches are the Rat, Monkey and Rooster, and its clash sign is the Dog, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Dragon, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Dragon, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Dragon years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1988 (Earth Dragon); 2000 (Metal Dragon); 2024 (Wood Dragon); 2036 (Fire Dragon). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2012 is the Year of the Dragon, a Yang Water Dragon year (Ren-chen).
When does the 2012 Year of the Dragon start and end?
It starts on 23 January 2012 and ends on 9 February 2013.
I was born in January 2012. What is my Chinese zodiac?
If you were born before 23 January 2012, you are a Rabbit; from 23 January 2012 on, a Dragon.
Water. 2012 ends in 2, which belongs to Water, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Dragon compatible with?
Traditionally the Rat, Monkey and Rooster. The Dragon's clash sign is the Dog.
